test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The most evident reason for cases pending in the Indian judiciary is an ________ representation of judges.
solution: The correct answer is **Option 4) i.e. "insufficient".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Insufficient: (अपर्याप्त)** - Not enough; inadequate. • **Example**: The food supplies were insufficient for the large number of guests. • The word fits perfectly in the context as it points out the reason for pending cases in the judiciary, which is the lack of enough judges. **Therefore, the correct complete sentence is *"The most evident reason for cases pending in the Indian judiciary is an insufficient__ representation of judges."*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ • **Adequate:** (पर्याप्त) - Sufficient for a specific requirement; satisfactory or acceptable in quality or quantity. • **Optimised**: (अनुकूलित) - Make the best or most effective use of a situation or resource. • **Unlawful**: (अवैध) - Not conforming to, permitted by, or recognized by law or rules. 15b:T9cc,
